note: What real MCP clients need in order to connect. Every line says where it came from. Lines without a verified source are marked UNVERIFIED and are not claims about the product.

clients.name: Any MCP client (per the MCP authorization page, 2025-11-25)

requirements.text: Use OAuth protected resource metadata (RFC 9728) for authorization server discovery; use resource_metadata from WWW-Authenticate when present, else the well-known URIs.
Support both RFC 8414 and OpenID Connect discovery and try the well-known endpoints in the specified priority order.
Implement PKCE, verify code_challenge_methods_supported in the metadata (refuse if absent) and use S256 when capable.
Send the resource parameter (RFC 8707) on both authorization and token requests, whether or not the server supports it.
Registration order: pre-registered client, then Client ID Metadata Document if client_id_metadata_document_supported, then Dynamic Client Registration if registration_endpoint, else prompt the user.
Handle 403 insufficient_scope by re-authorizing with the scope the server names.

clients.name: ChatGPT (and Codex), per OpenAI's Apps SDK authentication guide

requirements.text: Host protected resource metadata on the MCP server (well-known URL, or the same URL in WWW-Authenticate on 401).
Publish OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect discovery metadata from the authorization server; the issuer must equal the value in authorization_servers.
code_challenge_methods_supported must include S256; servers that omit it are unsupported.
ChatGPT appends resource to the authorization and token requests; copy it into the token audience.
CIMD, DCR or a predefined OAuth client. ChatGPT prioritizes CIMD when advertised; the plugin builder can choose DCR when both exist.

With authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported true and iss on every authorization response (errors too), ChatGPT uses its stable redirect URI; otherwise a callback-ID-specific one. If iss is advertised but missing or mismatched, the response is rejected.
OIDC scopes advertised in scopes_supported are requested by default; make sure each advertised scope is enabled for the client.

Claude's own connector requirements could not be fetched (the help-center page renders in JavaScript). Nothing specific is claimed. Treat the generic MCP client lines above as the working assumption and confirm against Anthropic's current documentation before telling a customer.
